_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: L. Dora Schmitz: Haeckel's The History of Creation (1876, 2 vols, rev. E. Ray Lankester). Her Schliemann is on schliemann_shelf.json (another lane). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 29); Adam may veto. No uids minted. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Elze's Essays on Shakespeare (1874) and William Shakespeare (1888), Ulrici's Shakspeare's Dramatic Art (2 vols, 1876), the Schiller-Goethe Correspondence (2 vols, 1877), Stinde's The Buchholz Family (1887) and Schiller's Revolt of the Netherlands (1897, with A. J. W. Morrison).
